shulkersorter.message.error.no_boxes: No shulker boxes found in inventory!
shulkersorter.message.error.not_enough_s: Not enough shulker boxes for all items! Sorting cancelled.

config.shulkersorter.title: ShulkerSorter Settings
config.shulkersorter.auto_label.tooltip: Automatically rename shulker boxes after sorting (e.g. 'Blocks #1', 'Ores #2')
config.shulkersorter.include_loose_items: Also sort loose items from your inventory into shulker boxes (disabled by default)
config.shulkersorter.skip_empty_boxes.to: When enabled, empty shulker boxes are ignored during sorting and left untouched in your inventory.
config.shulkersorter.overflow_mode.toolt:
What happens when there are more items than shulker box slots available.

Fill: Boxes are filled across categories until full — mixed content is allowed when space is tight. Remaining items stay in inventory.

Dominant: Each box is dedicated to one category only. Only the top categories (by item count) are sorted; items from other categories stay in inventory.
config.shulkersorter.loose_item_ignore_t: Items with this text in their name will not be sorted into shulker boxes (e.g. rename an item to '[KEEP] Diamond Sword')
config.shulkersorter.locked_tag.tooltip: Shulker boxes with this text in their name will be skipped during sorting
config.shulkersorter.tooltip_enabled.too: Show shulker box contents when hovering over them
config.shulkersorter.tooltip_max_lines.t: Maximum number of item lines shown in the tooltip (1-27)
config.shulkersorter.enable_chat_notific: Show chat messages when sorting completes or fails
config.shulkersorter.enable_sound_effect: Play a sound when sorting completes successfully
Show an animated 'Sorting...' overlay on the HUD during sorting
config.shulkersorter.category_order.tool: Order in which categories are matched during sorting. Items are matched top-to-bottom; the first match wins.
config.shulkersorter.category.enabled.to: Disabled categories are skipped during sorting. Their items fall through to Misc.
config.shulkersorter.category.patterns.t: Item ID patterns for this category. Prefix: 'raw_' (items starting with raw_). Suffix: '_planks' (items ending with _planks). Exact or substring: 'redstone'.
